acceptance: Accepted 2026-07-28 via DEC-0006 (GATE-0002 passed). This artifact now owns its enumerations; the canonical pack remains the prose explanation. Changes flow through ADRs and supersession.

property_types.description: Persistent fictional storyworld (serialized fiction, mystery, character IP).
Voice-led editorial property (illustrated essays, field manuals, reflective series).
Brand storyworld or product-centered campaign context originated with Commerce Foundry.
Authored world/mission/dialogue content compiled for a runtime target.
Combination of the above; mode behavior is additive, storage is shared.

mode_rule: Modes never create separate products, schemas, or databases; genre needs live in templates, vocabularies, validators, and target adapters.
